terms.title: Delivery of 100 widgets to Depot B
terms.claim: The supplier delivered 100 widgets to Depot B on 2026-10-10

criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

bound.findings: a majority of validators, each running the assessment itself, reproduced for each criterion whether it is supported, and so whether the claim is
leader_recorded: the finer label of a criterion that is not supported, and so of the overall finding

criteria.rationale: E-0002 states that 100 widgets were received at Depot B on 2026-10-10 and adds a count of 10 rows of 10. E-0003 likewise states Depot B confirmed receipt of 100 widgets against order 42 on 2026-10-10. E-0001 shows a sign reading Depot B, 100 widgets, and delivered 2026-10-10, which supports the same reported delivery details, though the photo alone does not prove when it was taken.
criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

limitations: The assessment cannot verify from the photo alone when it was taken or independently confirm the actual count beyond what the documents report.
This assessment does not decide legal liability, credibility, or whether any document or label was accurate when created.

observations.shows: A stacked pallet of many small cardboard boxes is shown indoors on a brown pallet base against a plain gray background. The boxes appear neatly arranged in rows and columns, with no visible damage or disturbance. A large sign in the upper right reads depot and order details, indicating delivery-related labeling in a warehouse-like setting.

decision.scope: Whether the filed evidence establishes each criterion the parties accepted before the evidence was filed. Not a legal finding, not a finding about who is telling the truth, and not proof of when a photograph was taken or that a file is authentic.
